core_problem_solved: To provide a powerful, modern, and feature-rich library for creating and manipulating PDF documents in Java.
key_features: All features of the original iText, plus support for modern PDF standards
Improved security features, better performance, and a redesigned API (in the latest 7.x series)
Advanced add-ons for features like PDF redaction, OCR, and HTML to PDF conversion
era_and_niche: The official, commercially-backed version of the iText PDF library. It is a leading commercial and open-source (AGPL) product for enterprise-grade PDF solutions. This coordinate refers to the 5.x series; the current generation is the modular iText 7 (e.g., `com.itextpdf:kernel`).
reason_for_obsolescence: This library is **not obsolete** but is licensed under the **AGPL**, which has significant viral open-source implications for commercial use, often requiring the purchase of a commercial license. It is the official successor to `com.lowagie:itext`. Its primary open-source (Apache licensed) competitor is **Apache PDFBox**, and the community-driven, permissively-licensed alternative is **OpenPDF**.
